Oreo Cream Pie
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 20, 2010 - 11:50pm

Ingredients




41 oreo cookies
1/4 cup margarine melted
24 lrg marshmallows
1/2 cup milk
1 1/2 cups heavy cream whipped

Preparation

1 Preparation Time: 0:25Coarsely chop 10 cookies; set aside. Finely roll 26 cookies into crumbs. Combine crumbs and margarine. Press evenly into bottom and on sides of a 9-inch pan. Chill while preparing filling, In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, stir marshmallows and milk until melted and smooth; cool completely. Fold 2 cups of the whipped cream into cooled marshmallow mixture. Fold in chopped coo
